game_version_note: Latest version number in the official patch notes on the fetch date (Steam post 2026-10-07 UTC).
sources_note: 一手来源：Steam appdetails / 商店页、Steam 官方公告（ISteamNews，215 条官方帖）、官网 kineticgames.co.uk 新闻页、Steam 成就页与成就百分比 API。字段级 *_source 标具体出处；*_as_of 标该值最后一次被一手来源陈述的日期；unverified_fields 列出「只有旧公告支撑、之后未被重述」或「一手来源未给」的字段。未用任何 B / C 级数据。成就名与描述逐字取自成就页 HTML（raw/achievements_parsed.json），6 条不显示描述的成就不填 requirement。
_page_slug_note: page_slug 指向 content/en/<slug>.md；achievement 全部指向 achievements，update 指向 patch-notes，event / twitch_drop 指向 events（crimson-eye-2026 指向 crimson-eye）。

phasmophobia.summary_en: 4-player online co-op psychological horror game by Kinetic Games, in Steam Early Access since September 18, 2020.
phasmophobia.description_en: Phasmophobia is a 4 player online co-op psychological horror. Paranormal activity is on the rise and it’s up to you and your team to use all the ghost-hunting equipment at your disposal in order to gather as much evidence as you can.
phasmophobia.platforms: PC (Windows, VR supported) · PlayStation 5 · PS VR2 · Xbox Series X/S
phasmophobia.platforms_note_en: Steam appdetails lists windows=true, mac=false, linux=false; the console list is from the developer's November 2025 patch notes.
phasmophobia.reviews_all_languages_en: Very Positive, 94% positive of 840,982 reviews (all languages, read 2026-10-10)
phasmophobia.full_release_window_en: Second half of 2027 (1.0), with the Nintendo Switch 2 version at the same time
phasmophobia.key_notes_en: Optional crossplay between PC and consoles; the Steam store page's Early Access answer still says second half of 2026, which the June 24, 2026 post supersedes.

values: second half of 2026 (Steam store Early Access Q&A)

custom-difficulty.summary_en: A difficulty where each option is tied to a reward multiplier; players can save presets and, since v0.19.0.0, choose the ghost type at the cost of a 0 multiplier.
custom-difficulty.zero_multiplier_rule_en: Custom Difficulties with a 0 multiplier will no longer contribute towards any progress, such as achievements and leaflets.
custom-difficulty.key_notes_en: Selecting the Ghost Type sets the multiplier to 0 (v0.19.0.0). The 15x cap (February 2023), preset count (September 2022) and unlock level (October 2024) come from older patch notes and have not been restated since.
custom-difficulty.unverified_note_en: Latest first-hand statements for these three fields date from 2022 to 2024; no later announcement changes them, but none re-confirms them either.

apocalypse-challenge.summary_en: Custom-difficulty challenge on Sunny Meadows with Bronze, Silver and Gold trophies at multipliers of 6, 10 and 15, as stated in the June 2024 patch notes.
apocalypse-challenge.requirement_en: Correctly identify the ghost, take a ghost photo and complete all objectives on Sunny Meadows with a difficulty multiplier of 6 or higher (Bronze), 10 or higher (Silver) or 15 (Gold)
apocalypse-challenge.key_notes_en: Since v0.18.0.0 (July 21, 2026): "You can now capture any Media for the Apocalypse challenge, instead of only a photo."
apocalypse-challenge.multiplayer_note_en: January 2023 hotfix: "You can no longer complete the apocalypse challenge in multiplayer mode while solo or after other players leave"; not restated since.

media-system.summary_en: Since the Chronicle update, an investigation holds five photos, five videos and three sound recordings, each marked Unique or Duplicate.
media-system.key_notes_en: A Duplicate rewards less money and experience; since v0.19.0.0 cameras and Sound Recorders indicate Duplicate evidence on the device.

weekly-challenge.summary_en: A weekly rotational difficulty with a free challenge-specific loadout; completing it 3 times on the specified map grants a large money and XP bonus.
weekly-challenge.key_notes_en: "You will lose nothing if you fail or die" (2023 notes). The June 2026 roadmap says a later content update will change Weekly Challenges.

difficulty-amateur.key_notes_en: Long setup time; long hunt grace period; short hunt duration; sanity pills restore a lot of sanity; regain half of your lost equipment's value if you die

difficulty-intermediate.key_notes_en: Average setup time; average hunt grace period; average hunt duration; sanity pills restore some sanity; fuse box starts off; fewer places to hide; regain some of your lost equipment's value if you die

difficulty-professional.key_notes_en: The ghost can very rarely change its preferred room after moving; no setup time; short hunt grace period; long hunt duration; sanity pills restore little sanity; fuse box starts off; much fewer hiding places

difficulty-nightmare.description_en: A new difficulty for the top ghost hunters
difficulty-nightmare.key_notes_en: Ghosts will not reveal one type of evidence; the ghost will sometimes change its preferred room after moving; no setup time; shortest hunt grace period; long hunt duration; kills extend the current hunt's duration; sanity pills restore much less sanity; fuse box starts off; almost no hiding places; some monitoring equipment damaged

difficulty-insanity.description_en: For the best investigators, a new default difficulty has been added: Insanity.
difficulty-insanity.key_notes_en: More information can be found in-game on the difficulty selection screen.

crimson-eye-2026.key_notes_en: Schedule as announced on October 1, 2026; the official site version adds an edit moving the patch to October 7. Not confirmed in game by us.

drop-crimson-eye-tee.status_en: Announced on October 1, 2026; scheduled to run from the start of the event until 11:59 PM BST on October 15. No later official post confirms it has started.
